full_script.title: Tesla aur SpaceX ka $3 Trillion Merger?
full_script.description: Kya Elon Musk ki Tesla aur SpaceX milne ja rahi hain? Janiye is reported 3 trillion dollar deal ki mukammal tafseelaat.
full_script.narration: Kya aap ne socha hai ke 3 trillion dollar ki company kaisi dikhegi? Reports ke mutabiq, Elon Musk Tesla aur SpaceX ko aapas mein milane ki exploration kar rahe hain. Tesla electric cars banati hai aur SpaceX rockets aur space travel par kaam karti hai. Agar yeh merger ho gaya, toh ek aisi technology giant ban sakti hai jis ki value 3 trillion dollars se bhi zyada hogi. Is ke ilawa, ek aur hairan kun baat samne aayi hai. Reports ke mutabiq, AI ab SpaceX ko satellite connectivity division se bhi zyada sales de raha hai. Lekin sochiye, is tarah ka merger investors aur mukabla karne wali companies ke liye kya maikhne rakhta hai? Is ke kuch risks bhi hain aur abhi tak yeh sirf reports hain, koi confirm deal nahi hui. Toh aap batayein, kya Tesla aur SpaceX ka merger sahi faisla hoga?
